cards.card_text: Then Miriam the prophetess takes a tambourine in her hand.
cards.verse_text: Then Miriam the prophetess, Aaron’s sister, took a tambourine in her hand, and all the women followed her with tambourines and dancing.

cards.card_text: Deborah, a prophetess, is judging Israel, and the Israelites come to her for judgment under the Palm of Deborah.
cards.verse_text: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, was judging Israel at that time.
cards.snippet: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, was judging Israel at that time.

cards.card_text: He asks God to remember Tobiah and Sanballat for what they've done, along with Noadiah the prophetess and the other prophets who tried to intimidate him.
cards.verse_text: O my God, remember Tobiah and Sanballat for what they have done, and also Noadiah the prophetess and the other prophets who tried to intimidate me.
cards.snippet: …Tobiah and Sanballat for what they have done, and also Noadiah the prophetess and the other prophets who tried to intimidate me.

cards.card_text: Then Isaiah says he had relations with the prophetess, and she conceives and gives birth to a son.
cards.verse_text: And I will appoint for Myself trustworthy witnesses—Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah.” And I had relations with the prophetess, and she conceived and gave birth to a son.
cards.snippet: …priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah.” And I had relations with the prophetess, and she conceived and gave birth to a son.

cards.card_text: Now meet Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, from the tribe of Asher.
cards.verse_text: There was also a prophetess named Anna, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher, who was well along in years.

cards.card_text: It's about that woman Jezebel (not King Ahab's wife), who calls herself a prophetess.
cards.verse_text: But I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess.
cards.snippet: …this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess.
